semantic_authority: Project 03 — Start CV Learning Spotlight final editorial adjudication and English source freeze, 07 September 2026
linguistic_authority: Project 09 — Start CV Portuguese localization packet, 07 September 2026 (READY_FOR_PROJECT_04_IMPLEMENTATION)
intent: Supplies the governed EN/PT presentation strings for the incoming Start CV Learning Spotlight record. Strictly additive: every key is new under training.record.start-cv.*, no previously approved key is reopened or retranslated, no English source value is modified, and no lifecycle, publication, currentness or media policy is altered. The outgoing Myrtle Atividades Educativas record keeps every one of its approved keys unchanged; only its spotlight presentation treatment is withdrawn in data/training-opportunities.json, which this package does not touch.
facts_intentionally_omitted: any total language count, because current first-party sources conflict between eight and nine
published class schedules or opening hours
confirmed next cohort or course start dates
student numbers, success rates or other outcomes
translation, localization, proofreading, transcription, interpreting or residency/start-up-assistance services
unverified terms of the separately promoted German Job Ready bootcamp
legal/registered entity status not established by the current evidence

rows.pt: Cursos de Línguas na Start CV
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record.
rows.linguistic_notes: Provider identity "Start CV" is preserved verbatim; only the surrounding phrase is translated.

rows.pt: Candidaturas e pedidos de informação para cursos de línguas atualmente disponíveis
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record.
rows.linguistic_notes: Preserves the narrow intake meaning: an application/enquiry can currently be submitted. It does not state that every listed course, level or class currently has places.

rows.source_en: Madeiralzinho, Mindelo · In person, online and hybrid
rows.pt: Madeiralzinho, Mindelo · Presencial, online e híbrido
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record.
rows.linguistic_notes: Place names Madeiralzinho and Mindelo are locale-independent and carried verbatim.

rows.source_en: Start CV offers language courses in English, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Cape Verdean Creole (Kriolu) from its language school in Mindelo.
rows.pt: A Start CV oferece cursos de inglês, francês, alemão, neerlandês, italiano, espanhol, português e crioulo cabo-verdiano (Kriolu) na sua escola de línguas em Mindelo.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Card summary body.
rows.linguistic_notes: "neerlandês" is the European-Portuguese language name for Dutch. "crioulo cabo-verdiano (Kriolu)" preserves the general Cape Verdean Creole identification without assigning an island variety the source does not establish. No total number of languages is stated in either locale.

rows.source_en: Start CV provides language courses from Rua Humberto Fonseca in Madeiralzinho, Mindelo.
rows.pt: A Start CV oferece cursos de línguas a partir da Rua Humberto Fonseca, em Madeiralzinho, Mindelo.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Detail body paragraph 1 of 4.
rows.linguistic_notes: Street and place identity (Rua Humberto Fonseca, Madeiralzinho, Mindelo) carried verbatim.

rows.source_en: Current first-party course information lists English, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Cape Verdean Creole (Kriolu). The provider states that courses may be delivered in person, online or in a hybrid format.
rows.pt: A informação atual disponibilizada diretamente pelo prestador apresenta cursos de inglês, francês, alemão, neerlandês, italiano, espanhol, português e crioulo cabo-verdiano (Kriolu). A Start CV indica que os cursos podem ser ministrados presencialmente, online ou em formato híbrido.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Detail body paragraph 2 of 4.
rows.linguistic_notes: Attribution to the provider is preserved in both locales; no delivery mode is asserted beyond what the provider states. No total number of languages is stated.

rows.source_en: A current application form is available for prospective learners to provide their preferred course, start date, level and study frequency.
rows.pt: Está disponível um formulário de candidatura atual para que potenciais alunos indiquem o curso pretendido, a data de início preferida, o nível e a frequência de estudo.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Detail body paragraph 3 of 4.
rows.linguistic_notes: Describes what the form collects. It does not state that a preferred course, start date, level or frequency is accepted or available.

rows.source_en: Contact Start CV directly for current course availability, scheduling, fees and enrollment arrangements.
rows.pt: Contacte diretamente a Start CV para confirmar a disponibilidade atual dos cursos, horários, propinas e condições de inscrição.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Detail body paragraph 4 of 4, immediately preceding the governed contact block.
rows.linguistic_notes: Directs the reader to the provider for the facts the spotlight deliberately does not assert.

rows.source_en: The presence of a live application form means Start CV is currently accepting course enquiries/applications. It does not confirm that a particular language, level, class time or preferred start date has an available place.
rows.pt: A existência de um formulário de candidatura ativo significa que a Start CV está atualmente a receber candidaturas e pedidos de informação sobre os cursos. Isto não confirma que exista vaga disponível para uma determinada língua, nível, horário ou data de início pretendida.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Good-to-know paragraph 1 of 2.
rows.linguistic_notes: Carries the governed intake semantics: an active form evidences intake, never guaranteed enrolment, a guaranteed place, a confirmed start date or acceptance of a preferred level or frequency.

rows.source_en: Course fees, general course lengths and published class schedules are not established in the current source information. Confirm current arrangements directly with Start CV before enrolling.
rows.pt: As propinas, a duração geral dos cursos e os horários das aulas publicados não estão estabelecidos na informação atualmente disponível. Confirme diretamente com a Start CV as condições atuais antes de se inscrever.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Good-to-know paragraph 2 of 2.
rows.linguistic_notes: States what the current evidence does not establish. No fee, duration or timetable is introduced in either locale.

rows.source_en: Checked 7 September 2026 against Start CV's official website, current course listings, live application form and contact information, with recent first-party Facebook activity used as an additional currentness signal.
rows.pt: Revisto em 7 de setembro de 2026 com base no site oficial da Start CV, na lista atual de cursos, no formulário de candidatura ativo e nas informações de contacto, utilizando também atividade recente da própria Start CV no Facebook como sinal adicional de atualidade.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Provenance/currentness line.
rows.linguistic_notes: Date rendered in the European-Portuguese long form. "Facebook" is a locale-independent platform identity.

rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Card and detail external action label for https://startcv.cv/courses/.
rows.linguistic_notes: Neutral navigational label; it makes no availability or enrolment promise.

rows.source_en: Learning Spotlight is an independent A PRASA editorial selection. Inclusion does not mean A PRASA operates, accredits, certifies, endorses or sponsors this provider.
rows.pt: O Learning Spotlight é uma seleção editorial independente da A PRASA. A inclusão não significa que a A PRASA opere este prestador, lhe atribua acreditação ou certificação, o recomende ou patrocine.
rows.context_notes: Home Learning Spotlight card and detail presentation for the Start CV language-course record. Learning Spotlight editorial disclosure, rendered on both the card and the detail dialog.
rows.linguistic_notes: Project 09 identity policy as supplied: "TRANSLATE — preserve A PRASA". The protected brand string A PRASA is carried verbatim. The Portuguese value supplied by Project 09 retains the English feature name "Learning Spotlight" in running text; the separately approved card label key spotlight.learning.label renders "Destaque de Aprendizagem". Both values are implemented exactly as governed and the divergence is referred to Project 09 rather than reconciled here.
